attributes.name: [Chargeback Serverless] Project daily spend spike vs. 7-day baseline

esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup
| EVAL threshold_pct_increase = 50.0, min_daily_spend = 25.0, filter_project = "*"
| INLINE STATS latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE @timestamp >= latest_ts - 7 days
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
| RENAME project_id AS _b_pid, project_name AS _b_pname, project_type AS _b_ptype, has_native_billing AS _b_has_nat, conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _b_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _b_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _b_sym
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_project_status_lookup ON composite_key
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _ps_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _ps_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _ps_sym
| EVAL @timestamp = ts
| EVAL project_id = COALESCE(_b_pid, project_id)
| EVAL project_name = CASE(_b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "" AND _b_pname != project_id, _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "" AND project_name != project_id, project_name, _b_pname IS NOT NULL AND _b_pname != "", _b_pname, project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id)
| EVAL project_type = CASE(_b_ptype IS NOT NULL AND _b_ptype != "" AND _b_ptype != "unknown", _b_ptype, project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, _b_ptype)
| EVAL _b_u_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_b_unit)), null), _ps_u_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_ps_unit)), null), _b_s_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_b_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_b_sym), null), _ps_s_clean = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_ps_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_ps_sym), null)
| EVAL _prefer_ps_cur = (NOT COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false) AND _ps_u_clean IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(_b_u_clean, "USD") == "USD" AND COALESCE(_b_rate, 1.0) == 1.0)
| EVAL _row_rate = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_rate, _b_rate, 1.0), COALESCE(_b_rate, _ps_rate, 1.0)), _row_unit = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_u_clean, _b_u_clean, "USD"), COALESCE(_b_u_clean, _ps_u_clean, "USD")), _row_sym = CASE(_prefer_ps_cur, COALESCE(_ps_s_clean, _b_s_clean, "$"), COALESCE(_b_s_clean, _ps_s_clean, "$"))
| EVAL _cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN serverless_chargeback_conf_lookup ON _cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| RENAME conf_chargeable_unit_rate AS _cfg_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit AS _cfg_unit, conf_currency_symbol AS _cfg_sym
| DROP _cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date
| EVAL _cu = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(_cfg_unit)), null), _cs = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(_cfg_sym)) > 0, TRIM(_cfg_sym), null)
| EVAL conf_chargeable_unit_rate = COALESCE(_cfg_rate, _row_rate, 1.0), unit = COALESCE(_cu, _row_unit, "USD"), currency_symbol = COALESCE(_cs, _row_sym, "$")
| EVAL _is_auth_cur = (_cu IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(_b_has_nat, false) OR _ps_u_clean IS NOT NULL OR unit != "USD" OR conf_chargeable_unit_rate != 1.0)
| EVAL _lu_auth = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND _is_auth_cur, unit, null), _lu = CASE(ts == latest_ts, unit, null), _au = CASE(_is_auth_cur, unit, null)
| INLINE STATS _latest_auth_unit = MAX(_lu_auth), _latest_unit = MAX(_lu), _any_auth_unit = MAX(_au), _any_unit = MAX(unit)
| EVAL rep_unit = COALESCE(_latest_auth_unit, _latest_unit, _any_auth_unit, _any_unit, "USD")
| EVAL _lra = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND _is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _lrr = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _ara = CASE(_is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _arr = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, null), _lsa = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND _is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null), _lrs = CASE(ts == latest_ts AND unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null), _asa = CASE(_is_auth_cur AND unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null), _ars = CASE(unit == rep_unit, currency_symbol, null)
| INLINE STATS _latest_auth_rate = MAX(_lra), _latest_rep_rate = MAX(_lrr), _any_auth_rate = MAX(_ara), _any_rep_rate = MAX(_arr), _latest_auth_sym = MAX(_lsa), _latest_rep_sym = MAX(_lrs), _any_auth_sym = MAX(_asa), _any_rep_sym = MAX(_ars)
| EVAL rep_rate = COALESCE(_latest_auth_rate, _latest_rep_rate, _any_auth_rate, _any_rep_rate, 1.0), rep_sym = COALESCE(_latest_auth_sym, _latest_rep_sym, _any_auth_sym, _any_rep_sym, CASE(rep_unit == "EUR", "€", rep_unit == "GBP", "£", rep_unit == "ZAR", "R", "$"))
| EVAL eff_rate = CASE(unit == rep_unit, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, rep_rate), unit = rep_unit, currency_symbol = rep_sym
| DROP _b_has_nat, _b_u_clean, _ps_u_clean, _b_s_clean, _ps_s_clean, _prefer_ps_cur, _is_auth_cur, _lu_auth, _lu, _au, _latest_auth_unit, _latest_unit, _any_auth_unit, _any_unit, _lra, _lrr, _ara, _arr, _lsa, _lrs, _asa, _ars, _latest_auth_rate, _latest_rep_rate, _any_auth_rate, _any_rep_rate, _latest_auth_sym, _latest_rep_sym, _any_auth_sym, _any_rep_sym, rep_unit, rep_rate, rep_sym
| EVAL units = CASE(total_ecu IS NOT NULL, total_ecu, 0.0)
| EVAL cost = units * eff_rate
| DROP eff_rate
| EVAL project = CASE(project_name IS NOT NULL AND project_name != "", project_name, project_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id != "", project_id, "organization")
| EVAL project_type_label = CASE(project_type IS NOT NULL AND project_type != "", project_type, "organization")
| EVAL category_label = COALESCE(cost_category, "other")
| EVAL cost_type_label = COALESCE(cost_type, "other")
| EVAL project_type = project_type_label
| EVAL day_ts = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| STATS day_spend = SUM(cost), day_ecu = SUM(units), day_project = MAX(project), day_project_type = MAX(project_type), filter_project = MAX(filter_project), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct_increase), min_spend = MAX(min_daily_spend), sym = COALESCE(MAX(currency_symbol), "$"), unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "USD") BY day_ts, project_id
| INLINE STATS latest_day_ts = MAX(day_ts)
| EVAL is_latest = (day_ts == latest_day_ts)
| EVAL latest_val = CASE(is_latest, day_spend, null), baseline_val = CASE(NOT is_latest, day_spend, null), latest_ecu_val = CASE(is_latest, day_ecu, null), latest_project = CASE(is_latest, day_project, null), latest_project_type = CASE(is_latest, day_project_type, null)
| STATS latest_spend = ROUND(MAX(latest_val), 2), baseline_avg = ROUND(AVG(baseline_val), 2), baseline_days = COUNT(baseline_val), ecu = ROUND(MAX(latest_ecu_val), 2), project = COALESCE(MAX(latest_project), MAX(day_project), project_id), all_projects = VALUES(day_project), project_type = COALESCE(MAX(latest_project_type), MAX(day_project_type), "organization"), filter_project = MAX(filter_project), day = LEFT(TO_STRING(MAX(latest_day_ts)), 10), threshold_pct = MAX(threshold_pct), min_spend = MAX(min_spend), sym = COALESCE(MAX(sym), "$"), unit = COALESCE(MAX(unit), "USD") BY project_id
| WHERE filter_project == "*" OR project == filter_project OR MV_CONTAINS(all_projects, filter_project) OR project_id == filter_project
| WHERE latest_spend IS NOT NULL AND latest_spend >= min_spend AND baseline_days > 0 AND baseline_avg > 0.0
| EVAL pct_increase = ROUND((latest_spend - baseline_avg) * 100.0 / baseline_avg, 1)
| WHERE pct_increase > threshold_pct
| SORT pct_increase DESC, latest_spend DESC
| EVAL result = CONCAT("[", day, "] Project `", project, "` (", project_type, ") daily spend spiked +", TO_STRING(pct_increase), "% to ", sym, TO_STRING(latest_spend), " ", unit, " vs. ", TO_STRING(baseline_days), "-day baseline avg of ", sym, TO_STRING(baseline_avg), " ", unit, " (threshold: +", TO_STRING(threshold_pct), "%).")
| KEEP result, day, project, project_id, project_type, latest_spend, baseline_avg, pct_increase, threshold_pct, unit
